query:
UPDATE bookings 
SET status = 'confirmed', updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE studentId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'test-mentee@test.com')
AND mentorId = (SELECT id FROM mentor_profiles WHERE userId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = '이윤호'))
AND status = 'pending'
LIMIT 1;
